text:
### Features & Benefits  
| Feature | What It Means | Customer Benefit |
|---|---|---|
| **Variable Rate** | Moves with BoE | You benefit when rates rise |
| **4.50%–4.80% AER** | Tiered by balance | Highest rate for higher balances |
| **Monthly Interest** | Paid every month | Compounding — interest earns interest |
| **No Fees** | £0/month | Keep more of your money |
| **Full Access** | Withdraw anytime | Emergency access if needed |
| **No Minimums** | Open with £1 | Easy for anyone to start |
| **Joint Accounts** | Two people per account | Great for couples or family |

raw_entities.name: Variable Rate Savings Account
raw_entities.description: A savings product with a variable interest rate that moves with the Bank of England base rate. The account offers tiered AER rates between 4.50% and 4.80% depending on account balance, with monthly interest compounding, no monthly fees, full withdrawal access, and no minimum opening balance. The product supports joint account arrangements.
context: Variable Rate | Moves with BoE | You benefit when rates rise
4.50%–4.80% AER | Tiered by balance | Highest rate for higher balances
Monthly Interest | Paid every month | Compounding — interest earns interest
Joint Accounts | Two people per account | Great for couples or family

raw_entities.name: Savings Account
raw_entities.description: A savings account offering variable interest rates tiered by balance, with monthly compounding interest, no fees, and full access to funds. The account can be opened with as little as £1 and supports joint ownership arrangements.
context: No Minimums | Open with £1 | Easy for anyone to start
Full Access | Withdraw anytime | Emergency access if needed
Joint Accounts | Two people per account | Great for couples or family

raw_entities.name: Joint Account
raw_entities.description: A joint account arrangement allowing two people to hold the savings account together, with shared access to the variable rate savings product and its associated benefits.
context: Joint Accounts | Two people per account | Great for couples or family

raw_entities.name: Account Balance
raw_entities.description: A dynamic variable representing the customer's current account balance, used to determine the applicable tiered interest rate (4.50%–4.80% AER) in product communications and statements.
context: 4.50%–4.80% AER | Tiered by balance | Highest rate for higher balances

raw_entities.name: Interest Rate
raw_entities.description: A dynamic variable representing the applicable annual equivalent rate (AER) for the customer's account, which varies between 4.50% and 4.80% based on balance tier and moves with Bank of England base rate changes.
context: Variable Rate | Moves with BoE | You benefit when rates rise
4.50%–4.80% AER | Tiered by balance | Highest rate for higher balances
